meta.title: GitHub manager
meta.description: Full-permission GitHub management: browser OAuth with every useful scope (repo, delete_repo, workflow, admin:public_key, gist, notifications), credentials and tokens AES-256-GCM encrypted on this machine only, and no OAuth App credentials shipped (register your own, or use environment variables). Multi-account switching and removal; 43 agent tools covering repo create/delete, code read-write-delete, SSH/GPG/deploy keys, Actions secrets, triggering and inspecting CI (runs, job steps, logs, artifact download, cancel), gh_push publishing a local directory through the Git Data API with changed-files-only uploads and credential blocking, and gh_api for any REST endpoint. No gh CLI and no separate PAT.
